label: Daniel 2
research_definition: Nebuchadnezzar's dream, its revelation to Daniel, and the explanation recorded in the chapter.
boundary_note: Keep the dream description separate from the recorded explanation.

label: Daniel 7
research_definition: Daniel's four-beast vision, heavenly court scene, questions, and explanations.
boundary_note: Record what Daniel saw separately from what was explained.

label: Daniel 9
research_definition: Daniel's prayer and Gabriel's message concerning seventy weeks/sevens.
boundary_note: Keep titles, pronouns, and time expressions distinct.

label: Jeremiah and seventy years
research_definition: The writings of Jeremiah that Daniel says he understood concerning seventy years.
boundary_note: This connection is explicit in Daniel 9:2.

label: Day of the LORD
research_definition: Passages that explicitly use the phrase 'day of the LORD'.
primary_references: Isaiah 13:6,9; Joel 1:15; 2:1,11,31; Amos 5:18-20; Obadiah 15; Zephaniah 1:7,14; Zechariah 14:1; Malachi 4:5
boundary_note: Do not assume every occurrence describes identical details.

label: Jacob's trouble
research_definition: The phrase and immediate statements concerning the time of Jacob's trouble.
boundary_note: Retain the exact wording and immediate context.

label: Four kingdoms
research_definition: Passages that explicitly state four kings or four kingdoms.
boundary_note: Do not equate separate sequences beyond explicit identifications.

label: Final kingdom
research_definition: Passages that state a kingdom established by God or given after judgment and not destroyed.
boundary_note: 'Final' is an index label; retain each passage's sequence wording.

label: Seventy units of seven
research_definition: The numbered period stated in Daniel 9:24-27.
boundary_note: Do not convert the unit in the observation layer.

label: Trouble and great tribulation
research_definition: Passages using 'time of trouble', 'Jacob's trouble', or 'great tribulation' wording.
boundary_note: Shared wording is a connection, not automatic identity.

label: Kingdom
research_definition: Kingdom statements within the selected prophetic framework.
boundary_note: Record owner, recipient, duration, and sequence exactly as stated.

label: Babylon
research_definition: Named Babylon passages relevant to Daniel's setting and Jeremiah's seventy years.
primary_references: Daniel 1:1-2; Daniel 2:37-38; Daniel 5:25-31; Jeremiah 25:1-12; Jeremiah 29:1-14; Jeremiah 50-51
boundary_note: Do not import external historical data into the observation field.

label: Prince that shall come
research_definition: The title or phrase in Daniel 9:26 and its immediate actions.
boundary_note: Do not identify the prince unless Scripture explicitly does so.

label: Messiah / Anointed One
research_definition: The title in Daniel 9:25-26 and passages that explicitly define Messiah terminology.
boundary_note: Do not merge 'Messiah the Prince' with 'the prince that shall come'.

label: City and sanctuary
research_definition: Jerusalem, the holy city, and the sanctuary as named in Daniel 9.
boundary_note: Keep people, city, and sanctuary as separate objects.

label: Desolation and abomination
research_definition: Desolation wording in Daniel and Matthew's explicit reference to Daniel.
boundary_note: Matthew 24:15 is an explicit connection to Daniel.

label: Command concerning Jerusalem
research_definition: The command to restore and build Jerusalem stated as the starting marker in Daniel 9:25.
primary_references: Daniel 9:25; compare 2 Chronicles 36:22-23; Ezra 1:1-4; Ezra 7:11-26; Nehemiah 2:1-8
boundary_note: Comparison events are not identified by those passages as Daniel 9:25's command.
